description: Recommended MCP servers for the AI-assisted automation platform.

github.purpose: Read pull requests, commits, issues, changed files, and code review context.

filesystem.purpose: Read and write local framework files, generated artifacts, memory, and reports.

playwright.purpose: Inspect browser state, capture DOM snapshots, screenshots, traces, and validate healed locators.

jenkins.purpose: Fetch build logs, stage status, artifacts, and trend history.

browser.purpose: Interact with local app/browser pages and validate visual or DOM behavior.

documentation.purpose: Retrieve official Playwright, Cucumber, Jenkins, Allure, and OpenAI-compatible API documentation.
